description: Import a real-world airfoil coordinate file into QBlade and perform aerodynamic analysis. Open QBlade and navigate to the Airfoil Design module. Import the NACA 2412 airfoil from /home/ga/Documents/airfoils/naca2412.dat. After importing, run an XFoil analysis on this airfoil with Reynolds number 1000000 (1e6) over an angle of attack range from -5 to 15 degrees. Export the polar analysis results to /home/ga/Documents/airfoils/naca2412_polar.txt.
